name: cmlmarketplace
description: Headless commerce SDK and reference marketplace for CheckMyLicense.

scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @cml-marketplace/core && npm run build -w @cml-marketplace/catalog && npm run build -w @cml-marketplace/server
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @cml-marketplace/demo-store
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && npm run dev -w @cml-marketplace/demo-store
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck -w @cml-marketplace/demo-store
scripts.check: npm run test && npm run typecheck && npm run build
